title: Fixed point theory for variational inequalities with fractional functional constraints: A resolvent-regularized approach
abstract: Classical variational inequality theory does not directly accommodate feasible sets defined by fractional (Caputo) functional constraints, since the associated projection operators lose the geometric structure available in the integer-order case. We introduce the fractional resolvent regularizer R λ α , built from the Mittag-Leffler representation of a fractional relaxation equation, and show it is nonexpansive on L 2 ( 0 , T ) for every regularization parameter and fractional order. Using this operator we formulate the Variational Inequality with Fractional Functional Constraints (VIFFC), establish existence, uniqueness and well-posedness via a composite nonexpansive fixed point map, and propose an extragradient-type algorithm with proven global linear convergence. A numerical example and applications to anomalous diffusion and viscoelastic contact are discussed.
